An '''orbital bioresearch facility''' [[Orbit/Legends|circled]]<ref name="Tainted Research" /> the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|23|Phaseera}}</ref> [[Phaseera]]<ref name="Tainted Research" /> in the [[Phaseera system/Legends|Phaseera system]], which constituted a part of the [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> An exceedingly rare implant was located aboard the orbital [[Space station/Legends|facility]].<ref name="Tainted Research" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a malfunction aboard the bioresearch facility caused it to crash on Phaseera's surface, at which point the station was destroyed. Subsequently, an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] obtained reports on the facility's crash-landing. The individual then dispatched a companion to recover any specimens from the wreckage of the station, from which the companion salvaged the implant.<ref name="Tainted Research" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The orbital bioresearch facility was mentioned in a Bionanalysis Crew Skill mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]], though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Tainted Research" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Phaseera [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the orbital bioresearch facility, in grid square P-8.<ref name="TEA" />
